desc: gummy candies, a small heap of chewy translucent fruit gummies in red, orange, yellow and green, glossy and lightly sugared, in a small dish
shredded cheese, a loose heap of fine pale yellow and white grated cheese strands in a small dish
a glass of thick smooth fruit smoothie, opaque soft pinkish-purple, with a straw
nabe soup base, a small donabe clay pot of steaming clear light brown soup broth with nothing in it, a wooden ladle resting on the rim
scones, two round thick golden-brown English-style scones, one split open showing a crumbly pale inside, on a small plate
Thai green curry in a bowl, a creamy pale green coconut curry sauce with chicken pieces, eggplant chunks and a few basil leaves
a Mont Blanc cake, a small dome piped all over with thin swirled strands of pale brown chestnut cream, topped with a glossy candied chestnut, on a small plate
baumkuchen, a thick round slice of layered tree cake showing many thin golden-brown rings, with a hole in the middle, on a small plate
rusks, a few thin crisp slices of twice-baked bread glazed with butter and sugar, golden with sparkling sugar crystals, on a small plate
paella in a shallow round pan, saffron-yellow rice with mussels, shrimp, squid rings, red pepper strips and a lemon wedge
gapao rice, a plate of white rice beside glossy stir-fried minced chicken with holy basil and red pepper, topped with a fried egg with a crisp edge
lasagna, a square portion of layered flat pasta sheets with red meat sauce and creamy white sauce, the top of browned bubbling cheese, on a plate
sake toba, thin strips of dried salted salmon, chewy dark reddish-brown flesh with silver skin edges, in a small dish
tartar sauce, a small dish of creamy white mayonnaise sauce flecked with chopped boiled egg, pickles and onion
chinsuko, a few small oblong Okinawan shortbread biscuits with ridged edges, pale golden and crumbly, on a small plate
a glass of almond milk, smooth opaque pale beige-white drink, a few whole almonds beside it
mixed dried fruit in a small dish, chewy pieces of dried mango, apricot, raisins, cranberries and pineapple
mixed fruit cocktail in a glass bowl, cubes of peach, pear and pineapple with white grapes and a red cherry in light syrup
anmitsu, a glass bowl of clear agar jelly cubes with a scoop of sweet red bean paste, white shiratama dumplings, a few red peas, mandarin and fruit pieces, a little dark brown kuromitsu syrup
Japanese lemon cakes, small lemon-shaped sponge cakes coated in a thin glossy pale yellow lemon glaze, one cut showing a soft yellow crumb, on a small plate
chocolate brownies, a few square pieces of dense fudgy dark brown chocolate cake with a crackled shiny top and walnut pieces, on a small plate
karupasu, a small pile of short thin dry sausage sticks, dark reddish-brown and slightly wrinkled, one cut showing the speckled inside
tteokbokki, chewy cylindrical white rice cakes and fish cake slices in a glossy thick red spicy gochujang sauce with green onion, in a shallow dish
financiers, a few small rectangular golden-brown almond butter cakes with crisp edges, on a small plate
